add_data_table_column.rationale: Adds a column to an existing data table.

add_data_table_rows.rationale: Inserts rows into a data table.

archive_workflow.rationale: Archives a workflow, removing it from active use. Reversible in n8n.

create_data_table.rationale: Creates a data table in a project.

create_workflow_from_code.rationale: Creates a workflow from SDK code. Inert until published or executed, both of which are separately governed.

delete_data_table_column.rationale: Permanently removes a column and all its data, by its own description.

execute_workflow.rationale: Runs a workflow against live third-party systems using its stored credentials. Side effects are whatever the workflow does.

explore_node_resources.rationale: Pass-through (read): resolves dropdown values from connected services, such as Slack channel names. Reads through credentials the workflow already holds.

get_execution.rationale: Pass-through (read): execution detail, optionally including run data.

get_workflow_version.rationale: Pass-through (read): the content of one historical version.

list_credentials.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): credential IDs, names, and types. Its description states it never returns credential secret data, so it confers no capability outside the bridge.

list_n8n_connect_services.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): node and credential types with managed-credential coverage.

prepare_test_pin_data.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): writes test fixture data used to keep test runs off real services.

publish_workflow.rationale: Activates a workflow for production. It then fires on its triggers, unattended, using stored credentials against live systems.

rename_data_table.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): a rename. Affects no data and is reversible.

rename_data_table_column.rationale: Renames a column, which breaks workflows referencing the old name.

restore_workflow_version.rationale: Re-applies a historical version over the current one, reverting production behaviour.

test_workflow.rationale: Pin data bypasses external services, but trigger, credential, and HTTP Request nodes without pin data still reach real systems.

unpublish_workflow.rationale: Deactivates a workflow, stopping production execution. An availability change, reversible.

update_workflow.rationale: Atomically edits nodes, connections, and workflow-level settings — including on a published production workflow.

validate_node_config.rationale: Pass-through (validation-only): lints a node configuration. No state change.

validate_workflow.rationale: Pass-through (validation-only): lints SDK code before creation or update. No state change.
